name: Bosque County, TX
findings: Bosque County has 65 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 19 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Bosque County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
